headline: Local English Professor’s Life’s Work Reduced To A Single Note Scribbled On The Back Of A Dry-Cleaning Receipt After Nobel Announcement
body:
Dr. Subhashini Rao, a senior literature lecturer at a suburban university, confirmed today that her lifelong attempt to decipher the works of the newly announced Nobel laureate has officially peaked at a series of cryptic marginalia found on the back of a crumpled receipt from a May 2023 dry-cleaning visit. The discovery occurred after Dr. Rao realized that the complex, genre-bending verses she had been struggling to parse for three decades were best summarized by the shopping list ‘Milk, Atta, and Dry-clean silk saree’ she had scribbled over the poet’s seminal anthology.

‘I spent the better part of the 90s trying to connect the classical mythological allusions to post-modern domestic trauma in her work,’ said Dr. Rao, while frantically searching her desk for a stapler to fix the receipt to her syllabus. ‘But honestly, looking at the receipt now, the connection between the existential weight of her syntax and my need to get that mustard stain out of my blue silk is the only piece of criticism that has ever felt truly honest.’

Department colleagues report that Dr. Rao has since canceled her remaining seminars to instead focus on expanding her dry-cleaning receipt into a 400-page monograph titled ‘The Stained Margin: A Memoir of Grocery Lists and Nobel Laureates.’ She expects the university to grant her a sabbatical to visit the dry cleaner for a formal interview regarding the state of her laundry during the publication of the poet’s collected works.
caption: Literature professors across the country are currently frantically checking their old shopping lists for hidden poetic brilliance after today's Nobel announcement. #NobelPrize #Literature #AcademicLife #DryCleaningPhilosophy (satire)
